subject: dossair
caption:
A brief that needs a meeting is not finished.

One page: the reader, the decision, the risk, the date. Write that before you open a deck.

slides.headline: A brief should fit on one page.
slides.body: If it needs a follow-up meeting, it is not done.

slides.headline: Keep the decision. Lose the tour.
slides.body: Name the reader, the choice, and the risk. Everything else is a tour of your notes.

slides.headline: Four lines, then stop.
slides.body:
The reader
The decision
The risk you accept
The date it goes live

slides.headline: People actually read it.
slides.body: Long briefs get skimmed. Short briefs get used.

slides.headline: Write the page before the slides.
